description_en: Pickles, papad, spices, bakery, mills, dairy products, beverages and small food service. FSSAI tier, labelling and home-kitchen premises decide most of the journey.
Dairy, poultry, goat and sheep, piggery, pond and biofloc fish farming, hatcheries and fish retail. Unit size, land or pond papers and category rates decide most results.
Nurseries, mushrooms, protected cultivation, custom hiring, cold storage, warehouses, grading, beekeeping, sericulture, bamboo and producer collectives.
Tailoring, handloom, embroidery, carpentry, pottery, metalwork, leather, jewellery, soap and cosmetics, fabrication, printing, packaging, plastics and building materials.
Shops, wholesale, online selling, street vending, salons, laundry, repairs, transport, homestays, clinics, coaching, contracting and other local services.
Software, apps, platforms, digital marketing, design and professional services. A thin path: DPIIT recognition, GENESIS, credit guarantee and the tax-exemption entity test.
